subject: science
concept: Designing and conducting a microscope-based investigation to observe real or virtual cells
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Planning and Carrying Out Investigations) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student uses a real or virtual microscope to observe prepared cell samples and records observations
exercise.pictorial: Student sketches and labels what they observed under magnification
exercise.abstract: Student identifies cell structures visible in their own investigation and compares them to diagram references

assessment.mastery_threshold: correctly identifies at least 3 of 4 visible cell structures in the investigation
misconception_flags: mislabels a visible structure based on assumption rather than actual observation

interest_binding: investigation sample generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
